title: Zesty Velvety Slovakian Cheddar Cheese Casserole
description: A salty and velvety Slovakian dish featuring cheddar cheese, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This Buddhist-temple-friendly recipe is brine-dry and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded cheddar cheese, cooked macaroni, sour cream, milk, smoked paprika, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
Mix all the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the plain breadcrumbs evenly over the top of the mixture.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Zesty Velvety Slovakian Cheddar Cheese Casserole hot and enjoy.
